question: In the context of digital world, what does PNG stands for?
solution:
The correct answer is **Portable Network Graphics**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the computer system, the **file extension** helps the computer as well as the user to identify the application type. After saving a file with a name, an extension is also added to it. 
 
• In the context of the digital world, **PNG** stands for **Portable Network Graphics**. This extension uses for the** picture** or **images **or **graphic files** on the computer.
 
• PNG file format is supporting **palette-based** images as well as **grey-scale images**.

**Thus the correct answer is** *Portable Network Graphics*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some file extensions are discussed below for examples.
 
 
• **.avi: .avi **stands for **Audio Video Interleave**. This extension uses for the audio and video files on the computer.
 
• **.html: ****HTML** stands for H**yper Text Markup Language**.
 
• **.gif: .gif **stands for **Graphical Interchange Format**. This extension uses for the picture or images or graphic files on the computer.
